name: sparx — News Feed
tagline: A high-signal news-feed template for a publication that reports and sells.
description: A dense front-page feed for a technology & business publication — a full-width lead over a rail of the day’s stories, a live journal, and a bespoke bylined article page, in a white-ground one-accent theme. Modelled on the tech-newsroom archetype; shipped as Frequency. Ships a light store (reports, a book, membership) to demonstrate content + commerce together.
